title: Settings
subtitle: Turn platform features on or off

gps_required.label: Require GPS for check-in / check-out
gps_required.description: When enabled, merchandisers and supervisors must be within 2 km of the store to check in or check out of a visit. When disabled, check-in/out works without a location check.

time_clock.label: Employee time clock
time_clock.description: When enabled, every employee sees a clock-in / clock-out button in the header, and the recorded time feeds the HR working-hours tracking.
